Issue #4203 reports that all file uploads fail with a "Malformed row" error on row 1 due to column/header mismatches from a Windows accounting export. A repository search for `IngestError` confirmed that `src/ingest/parser.ts` throws the "errors.rowShape" exception during parsing. Additional files involved in ingest errors include `src/ingest/errors.ts`, `src/ingest/queue.ts`, and `src/ingest/schema.ts`.

input.body:
label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts

File uploads fail on Windows accounting exports because the parser handles the Byte Order Mark (BOM) on the text string but doesn't strip trailing carriage returns (`\r`), leaving `\r` attached to the last header column name and causing shape assertion mismatches.
